notes.title: Lost Numbers is now available! ⚡
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

The Cyber Hook ✨Lost Numbers DLC✨ is now available! 🎉

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1726520/Cyber_Hook__Lost_Numbers_DLC/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35679914/631083df3761c056821fcfa51d8474dc1fc8144d.gif[/img]

Lost numbers it’s basically:
[list][*][b]30+ new levels:[/b] Dash through 30+ levels, more and more complex levels by climbing, running on walls, or using your hook.
[*][b]New gravity zones[/b]: Master the gravity to your will to finish levels in record time.
[*][b]New environment[/b]: Explore the post-apocalyptic Cyber Hook rhythmed by the hits of your cyber-hook and Drum & Bass. 
[*][b]N̵̰͒u̶̘͐m̵̽͜e̶͕͝r̶̄ͅo̶̖̓[/b]: Between the corrupted blocks, enemies, and the deadly fall, face the evil mastermind behind the bugs in an epic boss fight!
[*]Keep up to earn your spot at the top of the[b] Worldwide Leaderboards[/b] and watch others play in-game to determine the best strategies.
[*]Free DLC [b]updates[/b] to come!
[*]And more![/list]

[b][h2]Run through the levels with your new power[/h2][/b]

Dash through 30+ levels, more and more complex levels by climbing, running on walls, or using your hook. In addition to controlling your grappling hook, laser finger, and space-time, master the gravity to your will to finish levels in record time. But be careful, because it's not just the fall that can kill you, multiple enemies have appeared as well as bugs.

[b][h2]Discover the world of Cyber Hook in a new way[/h2][/b]

Yeah, the world is corrupted and it’s your job to fix it. Explore the post-apocalyptic Cyber Hook rhythmed by the hits of your cyber-hook and Drum & Bass. 


[b][h2]F̸̭̎̒ȃ̶̗̈́c̴̮̐́ē̵͓̙̑ ̷̢̰̂̌ȃ̸̗n̶̳̍ ̵̤̇e̷̬̊v̵̞̤̀i̶̛͔̯l̶͔͑ ̵̳̑b̸̈́͜ͅö̷̠́s̴͖̗̾s̶̻̣̎[/h2][/b]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35679914/56499907d213fdaba57960d7338fa384e48b1820.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35679914/d8af568f73bc3d1aa23eb1664c869dd14c741c48.png[/img][/url]

Dron had an assistant, a friend, but that was before. A story of vengeance is corroding the world of Cyber Hook. Discover and try to stop the destruction of the universe. But watch out! Between the corrupted blocks, enemies, and the deadly fall, face the evil mastermind behind the bugs: N̵̰͒u̶̘͐m̵̽͜e̶͕͝r̶̄ͅo̶̖̓ in an epic boss fight!


### [url=https://discord.com/invite/sh6DV2y]Join us on our Discord right now![/url] ###

And [url=https://twitter.com/blazingstick]follow us on twitter[/url] while you're at it!

notes.title: ⚡Gotta go fast to vote Cyber Hook for “Labor of Love” awards⚡
notes.content:
Hey there people 👋

[h2]Let’s gooooooo for the Steam Awards![/h2]

Even if we can’t participate in other categories to the Steam Awards (wanted to make Cyber Hook The Best Game You Suck At... 👀) But you can still help us to make Cyber Hook a nominee in “Labor of Love” award ❤️ 

It's been over a year that Cyber Hook is out! (Yup, you are here for one year 😌✌️) We are really happy to see more and more players from all over the world playing the game and making incredible runs!

📣[b]Vote Cyber Hook to support the Cyber Team![/b]📣

We will see soon for Lost Numbers...😉

notes.title: New CyberHook season is on!
notes.content:
[b]New Version 1.1.1 is up[/b]

[b]Ground boost deactivated![/b]
- People found a way to cheese GB and I don't have time to tweak it right now
- It might come back later reworked```

[b] Bug fixes: [/b]
- Fixed the ending of big bank not properly launching you through the ending opening
- Workshop and marathon bring you back to their respective selection screen
- Achievements "Relief at last" and "Isn't it a bit narcissistic" are easier to unlock
- Fix a glitch where wallriding without touching the mouse would spam the console and lag the game
- Lerp the speed blur a bit... who asked?


[b]New level to replace Master Airbender![/b]
No more pain for you little bois and boiettes

[b]Button "Reset to default"[/b]  added in control mapper

[b]HALVED the size of the game,[/b] the new update size is quite big because steam needs to rearrange 3/4 of the game

New cool secret bugs added for fun

[b]New CLEAN LEADERBOARD ![/b]
Since we removed Ground Boot it needs a good clean up
